spans.s:
अण r. 1st. cl. (अणति) To sound. (ङ,) 4th cl. (अण्यते) To breathe, to live;
with प्र, to exist, to live. See अन.

अणक mfn. (कः-का-कं) Inferior, low.
 E. अण to sound, अच् affix; and कन्
affix of depreciation; also written अण्णक, and आणक.
आणक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Low, inferior: see आणक.

अणव्य n. (-व्यं) A field bearing panic,
 E. अणु panic. and यत् aff.

आणवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bearing or fit to bear panic.
 E. अणु panic, and
खञ् aff.
